subject: Hospitality
title: Non-Alcoholic Beverage Boom
description: A fast breakdown of Non-Alcoholic Beverage Boom for builders.

hook.text: Non-alcoholic cocktails—'mocktails'—now appear on 40% of upscale restaurant menus.

buildup.text: Brands like Seedlip, Lyre's, and Athletic Brewing produce premium non-alcoholic spirits and beers that mimic their counterparts.

discovery.text: Non-alcoholic drinks cost less to produce but sell at near-equal prices. A $14 mocktail with $1.50 in costs beats many cocktails.

twist.text: Hotels that lack non-alcoholic options lose bookings from Muslim travelers, pregnant guests, sober-curious millennials.

climax.text: The best beverage programs make non-drinkers feel included, not sidelined. A dedicated mocktail menu signals respect.

punchline.text: Same price, lower cost, wider audience. The non-alcoholic boom is pure business sense.

quiz.question: Why are non-alcoholic cocktails often more profitable than regular cocktails?
options: Lower ingredient costs but similar selling prices
